description: Scan areas in Almeria (Spain). bbox_lonlat = [lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max] in WGS84. Boxes are approximate outlines of the greenhouse districts; check them on a map and widen if needed.

nijar_demo.note: About 3 x 3 km of the Campo de Nijar greenhouse belt; quick first test (about 16 chunks).

nijar_campo.note: Campo de Nijar greenhouse district and its ramblas (about 18 x 13 km).

campo_de_dalias.note: Poniente: El Ejido, Roquetas de Mar, Vicar, La Mojonera - the largest greenhouse area (about 29 x 15 km).
